items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03

ctx.x: We only have a little bit of tape left on this reel, but, um, I hate to get involved in an entirely new subject, but, uh, what was your very first recording session that you worked on in any capacity at all?

Well, my first recording session that I worked on in any capacity at all, uh, which is strange, was, uh, uh, on a recording of the Andrew Sisters by Mir Bistachain, which, uh, uh, the first session that I made under my own aegis, as it were, was a record of Dan Burley called Chicken Shack Shuffled, uh, 78, with, uh, Pop Sposter and Danny Barker and Jimmy Archie.
What were you doing with the Andrew Sisters? Uh, should I ask?
